testcase.system-out: Scenario: Parameter interface follows the active model state ✔ Given The MCAD Software has a Primary model state with d0 set to 1 in ✔ And Copy State has d0 set to "1 in + 0.5 in" ✔ And Copy State is active ✔ When the user opens Parameters ✔ Then d0 shows the arithmetic equation and nominal and model values of 1.5 in ✔ When the user closes Parameters and activates Primary ✔ And opens Parameters again ✔ Then d0 shows equation 1 in and nominal and model values of 1 in
